issues.detail: The Node.js section only lists SDK exports and tells the reader to adapt sample files from the a2a-js repo, with no runnable code, unlike the full Python server and client.
Both examples describe the implementation in prose without runnable code, and Example 1 relies on an unspecified classifier and an undefined `router.py`.

scenarios.name: streaming-task-server-with-cancel
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric: it enqueues the Task first, then WORKING, an artifact update and COMPLETED with no bare Message, and its cancel emits TASK_STATE_CANCELED. It also uses supported_interfaces with an AgentInterface (JSONRPC), sets streaming=True and passes agent_card to the handler. A uses the old 0.3.x API with a `url` field and no supported_interfaces, and passes no agent_card to the handler. It also sends the working and canceled states through TaskUpdater with messages, and its cancel does not use TASK_STATE_CANCELED.
